name: 原则：先分离再串行化共享状态
description_zh: 并发参与者可能写同一文件/分支/键/状态对象时：先消除共享；只有当「单一共享写者」是真实不变量时才做结构性串行化。
description_en: Apply when concurrent actors might write to the same file, branch, key, or state object. Eliminate the sharing first; serialize structurally only when one shared writer is a real invariant.
